purpose: Teach: 帯域/ファクター/環境省/入所/税務署/経済企画庁/自治省/付随

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、研究データの帯域確保を意識しろ
lines.en: Ren — be mindful of bandwidth constraints for the research data.
lines.style: Direct but not unkind. Clear instruction with the weight of experience. Leans forward slightly. Expects understanding without needing to repeat.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。実験の成功ファクターを整理します
lines.en: Yes. I'll organize the success factors from the experiments.
lines.style: Respectful, focused. Sits straighter. Quick intake of breath before responding — shows he's already thinking through the task. Steady, attentive eye contact.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、環境省の補助金も視野に入れろ
lines.en: Ren — keep the environmental ministry grants in scope too.
lines.style: Same measured tone as before. Places each clause deliberately, as if laying out stepping stones. Pause between instructions — gives him room to absorb.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。研究員の宿舎入所手続きを進めます
lines.en: Yes. I'll move forward with the researcher housing application process.
lines.style: Slightly faster intake, showing he's already ahead of the words. Deferential but not uncertain. The tone of someone taking careful notes in real time.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、税務署に研究奨学金の申告も忘れるな
lines.en: Ren — don't forget to file the research scholarship declaration with the tax office.
lines.style: Slight warning cadence on 'don't forget' — not scolding, but a reminder that details matter. Otherwise the same composed delivery. Holds his gaze.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。経済企画庁の旧資料も参考にします
lines.en: Yes. I'll also reference the older Economic Planning Agency materials.
lines.style: Calm acknowledgment. Soft pause after 'Yes' — he's already thinking ahead. The tone of a student who wants to do more than the minimum asked.

lines.speaker: hiroshi_boss
lines.jp: 蓮、自治省時代の地方政策研究も学べ
lines.en: Ren — you can learn from local policy research from the Ministry of Local Government days too.
lines.style: Opening slightly warmer than before — almost gentle encouragement beneath the instruction. Still measured, but with a hint that this is mentorship, not just directives.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: はい。論文に付随するデータも整備します
lines.en: Yes. I'll prepare all the accompanying data for the paper as well.
lines.style: Quiet resolution in the voice. Small nod. The final affirmation — he's integrated everything and is ready to execute. Slight fadeout, like he's already turning to the work.
